decisions.value: The snapshot generation boundary is Monday 04:00 UTC. The first read or reconcile tick after the boundary rebuilds it; reads before the boundary serve the previous generation. No scheduler-exact 04:00-05:00 execution is claimed.

A read on a logical server without the current generation builds it inside the request's serializable transaction. The periodic generation reconcile provider performs the same bounded refresh for servers that own player roots.
One snapshot per logical server. Each category source is filtered to that server; the global 1 on 1, Arena and Champions League surfaces are narrowed by the owning player's logical_server_id.
At most 100 rows are read from each category source per refresh. Fantasy reads at most 200 resolved attempts. Every scan is bounded.
At most 20 resolved formations are retained per category before detail assembly.
At most 50 table_ids are returned per category and at most 50 in total_rank_list.

The per-hero force board considers at most 64 candidate owners harvested from the same bounded source formations and popularity exemplars. It is not a full player_heroes scan; the server's full ownership set is knowingly out of scope.
At most 50 force rows are retained per recommended hero.

At most 3 formations are returned per category in one hero detail. Categories 4 (Fantasy) and 5 (Guild Event) return arrays; categories 1, 2, 3 and 6 return the first object, matching the client's getListLen/getKeyAndData shape.
sum(fights + 2*wins + kill_count) per partner over the server's top_floor_partner_usage
sum(fights + 2*wins + kill_count) per partner over the server's one_on_one_partner_usage
sum(fights + 2*wins + kill_count) per table_id over the server's arena_partner_usage
sum(resolved attempt damage) per partner over at most 200 server attempts; attempts are the only retained formation source
sum(server-record damage) per captured partner over at most 100 server records; records written before the formation capture carry no partners and contribute nothing
count of settled attacker lineups containing the partner over at most 100 server-scoped settled matches

Formations are ordered by source performance weight descending, then owner player_id ascending. Top Floor weight is the owner's summed partner usage; 1 on 1 weight is the owner's points; Arena weight is star*1000+point; Fantasy and Guild Event weight is damage; Champion weight is points.
Equal hero scores rank by lower table_id first. Equal force rows rank by lower player_id first.

Force is publicstats.Service.HeroTx with publicstats.Self for the owning player inside a CoherentReadScope built from the refresh transaction's exact content revision and decision time, rounded to int64. No force is derived from another player's Foreign view or from the fresh pool.

For an owning viewer, exceed_percent = count(stored force rows below the viewer's force) / max(1, len(stored force rows)), emitted as a fraction as the client multiplies by 100. A viewer outside the bounded board is compared against the same stored rows.

For an owning viewer, rank is 1 + count(stored force rows above the viewer's force); rank 0 and force 0 when the viewer does not own the hero. An unknown positive table_id returns my_rank {rank:0,force:0} and an empty rank_list.
2498 returns {} when the hero has no derived detail (no owning candidate and no force row). A recommended hero always has at least one owning candidate by construction.
No historical Guild Event formation is fabricated. Only new completed records with the captured owned formation partner ids contribute; the category is legitimately empty until such records exist.
Arena table ids that the owner's stock roster does not contain (summoned or otherwise unowned girls) are omitted from a formation and contribute no force, rather than inventing an owned row.
